messages:
maria: Hi all — support flagged AcmeCorp needing a temporary burst increase for Black Friday run. They're on the allowlist but current per-key quota blocks bursts. Can we clarify flow for temporary raises?

alex: Quick summary — we enforce at two layers: edge rate limiter (stateless, super fast) and service-level per-org quotas (token-aware). For temporary raises we need a safe bypass at the service layer, not the edge.

sanjay: Agree. Edge rules are hard to change mid-flight. Implementation idea: issue a short-lived 'quota_override' token scoped to org_id that the API accepts via X-Quota-Override header. Token contains allowed_rate and expiry. Example request:
```
POST /v1/generate
X-Quota-Override: eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-...
```

zoe: Support + Sales need a 1-click console flow: sales requests -> infra approves (or auto-approve if on allowlist + low risk) -> control plane issues override token. Token should be revocable and time-limited.

lisa-sales: Timeline constraint: sales expects same-day for big deals. We need a manual escalation path and clear audit entries for compliance.

support-bot: ticket#4579 created by @elena: AcmeCorp temporary raise request. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/4579

elena: To confirm, AcmeCorp wants +5x burst for 6 hours starting 2024-11-24 08:00 UTC. They will be hitting embeddings and generation endpoints.

maria: Security concerns: how do we prevent token reuse/leak? Token should be tied to org and ideally restricted by IP range or client fingerprint.

sanjay: Implementation details: JWT signed by control-plane KMS with payload {org_id, allowed_rate, expiry, nonce}. At runtime: verify signature and hit a small nonce-store in redis to ensure token single-use or short-lived. If we allow reuse, require short TTL and strict audit.

alex: Note: full JWT verification at the edge is expensive. Options: 1) route requests with X-Quota-Override to an auth-check path before hot path; or 2) push active nonces into a compact bloom filter in edge for quick positive checks and fall back to control-plane for misses. Tradeoffs: latency vs memory.

zoe: UX: console should show active overrides (org, granted_by, approver_role, duration, origin = sales/support), plus a revoke button and audit link. Also add an approvals log that ties to the support ticket. :eyes:

lisa-sales: +1 on templated customer email on grant and a scheduled reminder before expiry. Sales needs the exact window communicated.

elena: I'll update support runbook: I can approve up to +2x for 24h. Anything >2x or >24h needs infra review (SRE/infra oncall). Will start using the ticket workflow for AcmeCorp.

maria: Action items: 1) @sanjay prototype JWT override + nonce-store; 2) @alex propose edge bloom-filter vs auth-path tradeoffs; 3) @zoe wireframe console grant/approve page + revoke UX; 4) @elena update support runbook and ticket template. I'll follow up in #support with the exact docs. Thanks!
